text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Happy "birthday," obviously... It<n>seems the occasion
has Ticket crying<n>even harder than usual.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You think? Isn't she always like this?<n>I mean,
she'll cry for someone's<n>birthday even if she just
met them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Believe me, with how much time I<n>spend around
her, I can tell. She's<n>crying especially hard today.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Just the other day you were in bedwith a fever, but now here you are,turning one year older... I... Sniffle.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Oh please, what are you trying<n>to—hold on... are you
crying for real?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
H-Hayahide! I get you! It just makes<n>you so happy,
doesn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, gimme a break! What's wrong<n>with you two?!
